# AstryxOutline { #anylumino.AstryxOutline }

```python
AstryxOutline(
    items,
    *,
    active_id='',
    label='Table of contents',
    density='compact',
    **props,
)
```

Render a table-of-contents outline.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default               |
|-----------|---------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|
| items     | Iterable\[Mapping\[str, Any\]\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                             | _required_            |
| active_id | str                             | Currently active outline item id.                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `''`                  |
| label     | str                             | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                        | `'Table of contents'` |
| density   | str                             | Astryx density or spacing mode.                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `'compact'`           |
| **props   | Any                             | JSON-safe Outline props. Useful keys: data-testid, className, and style. anylumino manages items, activeId, label, density, and active-id synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Outline>. | `{}`                  |
